messages:
morgan_infra: noticing a spike of unready GPU nodes in us-west-3 during yesterday's scale event. bootstrap logs show KMS Decrypt AccessDenied, grant missing.

devon_sre: rolling log snippet: `2026-03-22T09:12:03Z bootstrap: decrypt bootstrap-token failed: GrantNotFound`. Affected nodes ~14 across two AZs.

reza_sec: ran audit: rotation service purged old grants (policy TTL 90d) and recreated grants, but it created them for `role/gpu-node` while our nodes use `role/gpu-node-usw3` after the rename. So new grant doesn't match principal.

morgan_infra: that explains the mismatch. autoscaler kept launching nodes but they fail at decrypt so pool never fills. We're at ~92% healthy capacity which triggers warm pool fills but those fail too.

toni_prod: customers with latency-sensitive routes might see tail latency spikes if traffic is shifted. ops estimated cross-region warmup to eu-west-1 adds ~1.5ms median and cost ~$900/day at current load.

devon_sre: immediate plan: two-prong mitigation:
1) Request a scoped emergency grant for `role/gpu-node-usw3` with 6h TTL to heal current nodes.
2) Start a small eu-west-1 warmpool (non-PII traffic only) and route low-priority jobs there until healed.

reza_sec: I can approve emergency grant after we post in #security-approvals and include justification + TTL. I'll also require a short audit entry for the action.

morgan_infra: posted request in sec channel. granting command we'll run once approved: `aws kms create-grant --key-id 1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/gpu-node-usw3 --operations Decrypt`

ops-bot: [ALERT] 6375567910 - keystore: repeated decrypt failures detected, cluster ml-usw3 failing nodes=14, symptom=GrantNotFound.

reza_sec: approved temporary grant ticket SEC-2027 (TTL=6h). I also changed rotation job to canonicalize principals by resolving role ARN rather than string match. Will push a dry-run to staging.

devon_sre: applied grant in prod. nodes started finishing bootstrap within ~2m of applying. autoscaler drained pending queue.

morgan_infra: verified capacity back to 99.2% healthy. keeping eu warmpool in standby and draining it slowly to avoid double-cost.

toni_prod: finance: track extra cost if standby warmpool runs >12h. Also capture support exposure for SLA credits.

reza_sec: follow-ups:
- fix rotation service to use resolved ARNs and to accept role aliases -> map to current principal.
- add unit/integration test: simulate role rename and ensure grants are re-created for resolved principals.
- emit metric `keystore.grant.reconcile.failures` and alert on >1 per hour per region.

devon_sre: I'll open INFRA ticket INFRA-4399 with the hotfix and test. I'll also add a runbook entry for emergency grant flow and link SEC-2027.

morgan_infra: suggestion: consider a short-lived KMS proxy in front of decrypt calls so node bootstrapping can retry while grants reconcile, reduces blast radius of rotation races. Put on roadmap.

reza_sec: we're evaluating the proxy idea; security wants a small design review first. For now, rotation job fix + metric/alert should mitigate recurrence.

ops-bot: [INFO] 6375568600 - cluster ml-usw3 recovered, healthy_percent=99.2; alert resolved.

morgan_infra: thanks team. please link INFRA-4399 and SEC-2027 in the postmortem and include cost delta and timeline. :thumbsup:
